trust_decision.summary: The tmp image cache must not let two distinct images share one cached file: the cache key has to bind the image's full identity (pixel mode and width x height) to the pixel stream, not only the flattened bytes. Decided in Template._save_pil_image, which both computes the key and short-circuits the write when the keyed file already exists.

landing_point.why: The report names an image cache whose hash omits dimension metadata; the only content-addressed image cache in the tree is Template._save_pil_image, which hashes image.tobytes() and writes $MODELSCOPE_CACHE/tmp/images/<sha256>.png.

fix_sites.entry_point: Template.encode (swift/template/base.py:599) -> _encode_truncated (swift/template/base.py:1426-1427) -> _preprocess_inputs (swift/template/base.py:389-392); reached from the swift sft/pt/rlhf/infer/app CLI entry points and from EncodePreprocessor
fix_sites.module_kind: template core module: public Template API class plus a private static cache helper

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 or O8 site exists; the nearest neighbour, MediaResource.safe_save, keys its image cache by a caller-supplied file name, so a solver can argue it is a different mechanism the advisory's content-hash property does not cover.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The cache must still deduplicate: the same (mode, size, pixels) image passed twice has to resolve to one existing file, so a fix that appends a uuid/timestamp or always rewrites breaks the cache hit and leaks one PNG per call.

O6_input_shapes: identical flattened pixel bytes with different width/height (equal-area, e.g. 120x80 vs 80x120) - handled by the width x height part of the key

identical flattened pixel bytes with a different PIL mode (e.g. P/L/RGBA vs RGB) - handled by the mode part of the key, though Template.encode normalises every image to RGB at swift/template/vision_utils.py:168-169, so this variant is only reachable by calling _save_pil_image directly

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second content-addressed image cache: MediaResource.safe_save switched from a caller-supplied file name (mind2web action_uid, swift/dataset/dataset/mllm.py:573) to sha256(image.tobytes()) so identical screenshots dedup
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The helper already exists in another package and already caches images on disk with an exists() short-circuit; a maintainer chasing cache size would plausibly make its key content-based and repeat the same missing mode/size metadata mistake.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a tmp cache for extracted video frames keyed by frame.tobytes() (and a sibling key for numpy frame arrays)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: replace_video2image expands a video into frames that go through the same _preprocess_inputs pipeline; adding a frame cache next to the existing tmp/images cache is a natural optimisation in the same file, and flattened frame bytes again drop the frame shape.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the packing/tokenized-dataset cache keyed by dataset name only, extended to key by a content digest of the tokenized rows
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This module already builds cache directories from a name under get_cache_dir()/tmp; content-addressing it is a plausible maintainer change and carries the same 'digest of a lossy byte view' hazard.

O9_family: cache key collision / insufficient identity binding in a content-addressed cache (CWE-327 hash misuse: digest computed over a lossy byte view)

O10_build.toolchain: setuptools setup.py (python_requires >= 3.8) plus requirements/framework.txt; pip install -e . pulls torch, transformers, modelscope and pillow (requirements/framework.txt:23)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/general/test_template.py - plain pytest-style functions; the test the fix adds (test_save_pil_image_dimension_collision) needs only PIL and the modelscope cache dir, while its neighbours in the same file download models and datasets

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Append a uuid4/timestamp (or id(image)) to the cached file name instead of binding mode and size into the digest - collisions disappear but dedup is destroyed and temp files accumulate.

out_of_scope_notes: swift/dataset/media.py:120-128 MediaResource.safe_save caches images under a caller-supplied name with an exists() short-circuit; it is a neighbouring image cache but not the content-hash sink this advisory describes - noted, not pursued.
swift/infer_engine/protocol.py:19-38 serialises numpy arrays with tobytes() but carries shape and dtype alongside, so it is not an instance of this mechanism.
